title: Keep band rows clear of FAB
prompt:
In lib/screens/bands/my_bands_screen.dart, the list already has bottom scroll padding, but that does not prevent a visible row from appearing underneath the floating button. Reserve space below the list viewport as well. Replace these exact lines:

        Expanded(
          child: filteredBands.isEmpty
              ? _buildEmptyState(bands.isEmpty)
              : _buildBandList(filteredBands),
        ),

with:

        Expanded(
          child: filteredBands.isEmpty
              ? _buildEmptyState(bands.isEmpty)
              : Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(
                    bottom: 56 + MonoPulseSpacing.lg,
                  ),
                  child: _buildBandList(filteredBands),
                ),
        ),

The 56 logical pixels are the standard FAB height, and MonoPulseSpacing.lg supplies the additional 16 pixels. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- lib/screens/bands/my_bands_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/bands/my_bands_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/bands/my_bands_screen_test.dart
